name: TAC Infosec Ltd.
summary: TAC Infosec Ltd., operating as TAC Security, is a global cybersecurity company specializing in risk-based vulnerability management and assessment solutions, cybersecurity quantification, and penetration testing services. The company delivers its offerings through a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) model. Its flagship product is the Enterprise Security in One Framework (ESOF) platform, which leverages artificial intelligence and machine learning for automated vulnerability detection, cyber risk scoring, and analytics. ESOF encompasses various modules such as ESOF Appsec for web and application asset security, ESOF VMP for risk-based vulnerability management, ESOF VACA for vulnerability and configuration assessments, ESOF PCI ASV for payment card industry compliance, ESOF CASA for cloud application security, and ESOF MASA for mobile application security. Additionally, ESOF CRQ provides cyber risk quantification. TAC Infosec Ltd. also engages in Web3 and blockchain security, enhanced by strategic acquisitions. The company targets a diverse global clientele including large enterprises, government organizations, and regulatory agencies across industries such as Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI), Government, IT & ITeS, and Manufacturing.
